text.title: 采访之后的短片
text.situation:
下一期节目会包括乔参观过的科学展览短纪录片。诺拉请三位读者看粗剪版。他们的科学知识水平不同，对一个人熟悉的词，对另一个人可能需要解释。一幅清楚的图能帮助理解，不必让屏幕堆满标签。乔写了知识在信息时代传播的引言，后来因为它耽误第一位讲述者出场而删去。即时获取信息有用，但片子仍需要让人看见说法的来源。最后一幅图旁留着来源链接，一位读者打开它，提出了比团队预想更好的问题。

读者：看完影片还能找到说明吗？
乔：能，下面有来源链接。
诺拉：请告诉我们哪部分还需要解释得更清楚。

paragraphs.en: The next programme would include a short documentary about the science exhibition Jo had visited. Nora invited three readers to watch the rough cut. Their levels of scientific knowledge differed, so a familiar word for one person needed an explanation for another. A clear drawing could facilitate understanding without filling the screen with labels. Jo wrote a short introduction about knowledge dissemination in the information age, then cut it when it delayed the first speaker. Instant access to information was useful, but the film still needed to show where a claim came from. They left a source link beside the final image. One reader opened it and asked a better question than the team had expected.

paragraphs.en:
Reader: Can I find the explanation after the film?
Jo: Yes. The source link is below it.
Nora: Tell us which part needs a clearer introduction.
